'''Dorheek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. During the war, he worked as a merchant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CodexHutta" /> On Hutta he owned a small stall in the market area of [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> an industrial town controlled by a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]].<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> The stall consisted of a large table with a cloth draped over it on which he placed sacks of the goods he sold, which included [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[sparkle powder]] which he sold for 125 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and [[Imperial targeting device]]s which he sold for 825 credits.<ref name="SWTOR" /> As all merchants in Jiguuna were, Dorheek was expected to pay some of his profits from his stall to one of Nem'ro's lieutenants at the crime lord's [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]].<ref name="CodexNem'roP">{{TORcite|type=codex|Nem'ro's palace}}</ref> Whilst at the stall the Kubaz wore a pair of goggles with red lenses to protect his eyes as well as blue shirt and pants. Dorheek had grey skin and purple hair.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dorheek first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears as a social items vendor on the planet Nal Hutta, the starting planet for players of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]] class.
